name: Product Hunt
description: The biggest launch stage for new tech products. Launching is free after sign-up; promoted 'Boosted' placements are paid ads.

name: BetaList
description: Features pre-launch and recently launched startups. All submissions are paid now, with an automatic full refund if your startup is not selected. Your product needs its own domain.

name: Uneed
description: Daily product launches with community voting. Free launch queue; paid options skip the line ($29.99), feature the listing, or add a premium yearly plan.

name: Microlaunch
description: Launch platform with a monthly competition. Free launch; paid tiers skip the queue ($39) or add featured spots and boosts ($129).

name: Fazier
description: Daily product launch platform. Free launch tier, plus paid options ($29-$69) with extra visibility.

name: TinyLaunch
description: Small launch platform. Standard launch is free and sits on the homepage for days; Premium ($39 per launch) gets showcased between top spots.

name: LaunchIgniter
description: Launch scheduling platform. Sign in with Google or GitHub and schedule your launch day.

name: Peerlist Launchpad
description: Weekly product launches inside the Peerlist professional network. Free with a Peerlist account.

name: Hacker News (Show HN)
description: Post a Show HN when your product is ready to try. Huge technical audience with strict rules: read the Show HN guidelines (news.ycombinator.com/showhn.html) before posting.

name: There's An AI For That
description: The largest AI tools directory, with a 2.5M-subscriber newsletter. Basic listing is a $49 one-time review fee, $347 with priority review. Once a month they run an X thread where one indie tool gets listed free.

name: Futurepedia
description: Big AI tools directory for work tools, claiming 400k+ monthly professionals. Paid listings only ($247-$497 one-time).

name: Toolify
description: High-traffic AI tools directory. Free submission form for tools and GPTs.

name: Vantaige
description: AI tools directory and media hub: 600+ curated tools, a prompts library and AI calculators. Free basic listing needs a backlink and a 2-4 week review queue. Paid: Verified badge $25 one-time, Featured $49/30 days or $99/90 days, Spotlight $189 for 90 days with homepage placement and a sponsored story.

name: TopAI.tools
description: AI tools directory with editorial review. $47 one-time listing, $229 featured for 7 days. Automatic refund if your tool is not accepted.

name: Future Tools
description: Matt Wolfe's curated AI tools directory. Free submission, manually reviewed before listing.

name: Dang.ai
description: AI tools directory. The free listing needs a crawlable backlink and takes up to 4 weeks; $49 skips the backlink and adds a Featured badge; Pro is $30 setup plus $19/mo.

name: Easy With AI
description: AI tools directory with permanent dofollow listings. $125 one-time fee; free for free or open-source education and research tools, 50% off for paid ones in those categories.

name: Toolpilot
description: AI tools directory. Free listing requires adding their badge or logo to your site first (link back).

name: SaaSHub
description: Software alternatives directory. Its /submit page doubles as a free, actively monitored list of 110 sites where you can submit your product.

name: The Rundown AI (tool submission)
description: AI newsletter with 1M+ readers. Its tool directory takes free submissions; newsletter ads are paid separately (see Newsletters section).

name: GPT Store (ChatGPT)
description: OpenAI's store for custom GPTs, inside ChatGPT. Publish from the GPT builder; eligibility depends on your plan.

name: Chrome Web Store
description: Home for Chrome extensions. One-time $5 developer registration, then publishing is free after review.

name: WordPress.org Plugins
description: Official WordPress plugin directory. Free submission, manually reviewed against the plugin guidelines.

name: Hugging Face Spaces
description: Host a live demo of your AI app. Free CPU tier; the AI community browses trending Spaces.

name: mcp.so
description: Large MCP server directory. Free submission with review; $39 one-time publishes immediately with a verified badge and a dofollow link.

name: Smithery
description: MCP server registry. Publish once, install anywhere, with built-in auth and observability. Sign in to publish.

name: Glama
description: Open MCP registry with 100k+ servers. Add your server with a glama.json file and claim the listing to manage it.

name: AppSumo
description: Marketplace known for lifetime-deal software launches. Applying as a partner is free; AppSumo takes a revenue share on sales.

name: G2
description: The biggest B2B software review site. Create a free product profile, then collect reviews. Paid seller tools are optional.

name: Capterra, GetApp and Software Advice
description: Gartner Digital Markets review network. One free vendor sign-up lists your product across Capterra, GetApp and Software Advice.

name: SourceForge
description: Business software directory with strong domain authority. Free listing; paid demand-generation programs drive buyer traffic to your page.

name: AlternativeTo
description: Crowdsourced software alternatives site. Add your product free with an account; it shows up as an alternative to competing tools.

name: Trustpilot
description: Consumer review platform. Claim a free company profile and collect reviews; paid plans add marketing and AI-visibility features.

name: Ben's Bites
description: AI newsletter with 170k+ subscribers. Product promotion runs through their self-serve ad store.

name: The Rundown AI (ads)
description: Daily AI newsletter reaching 1M+ readers. Paid sponsorships and takeovers; a separate free tool submission form exists (see Directories).

name: Superhuman AI
description: AI newsletter read in 3 minutes a day. Paid ad sponsorships through their self-serve advertising page.

name: r/SideProject
description: Subreddit for sharing side projects and getting constructive feedback. Post from a real account and read the rules first.

name: r/InternetIsBeautiful
description: Large subreddit for interesting websites. Heavily moderated: no basic or unoriginal sites, so only post something genuinely novel.

name: r/EntrepreneurRideAlong
description: Founder subreddit for sharing what you are building and how. Story posts do better than bare links.

name: r/artificial
description: The main AI subreddit. Strict on self-promotion: share real research, demos and technical substance, not ads.

name: Indie Hackers
description: Founder community for profitable online businesses. Share your product, milestones and revenue numbers.

name: mahseema/awesome-ai-tools
description: Popular awesome list of AI tools. Add yours by pull request, or submit free on the maintainer's altern.ai site.

name: steven2358/awesome-generative-ai
description: Curated list of generative AI projects. Add your project by pull request after reading the contribution guidelines.
